references_named: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
rationale: The CSS ::placeholder pseudo-element is a strong, genuinely web-native material: present only in absence, unselectable, unauthored in the DOM, and restored by emptying the field. The mechanism enacts the argument cleanly (P1) — typing destroys the work, which inverts relational aesthetics with a cheerful-cynic punch and gives the casual viewer an immediate surface gag while offering the literate viewer a layered read on authorship, reproducibility, and the AI-prompt-box trope. Restraint is exemplary (P3): one textarea, one pseudo-element, a dozen lines of script, a status line that updates live. The mechanism is materially distinct from the catalogue's other input-relation pieces (La Disparition, I Am Still Alive, I Do Not Wish to Add Any More, The Death of the Author) — none use the placeholder's specific shown-only-when-empty contract.
reservations: The narrative connection to the twenty-year argument is the weakest link: the work sits in the readymade/critique tradition but does not name a prior y-a-v-a work it answers, and the chance↔order axis is barely legible (per-visit accent hue is the only chance). The Benjamin 'aura restored' claim is a stretch — placeholder text being uncopyable is unhittable UI, not really aura; the argument works better as a riff on reproducibility than as a serious Benjamin inversion. Double-coding is uneven: the relational-aesthetics inversion surfaces immediately, but the authorship/aura layers require the motivation text.
revision_suggestion: Anchor the work in the catalogue by explicitly naming a prior piece it answers (e.g., l-h-o-o-q.org's perpetual loading state, But is it art?'s one-word affirmation, or @_hashtag_god's totality-through-form) — this would sharpen narrative. Either strengthen the aura argument with a more precise Benjamin inversion (e.g., the placeholder is the 'infrathin' between hint and content) or let it go. A tiny bit more legible chance (a per-visit wording variant on the placeholder, or a randomized per-visit frame) would put the work more clearly on the chance/order axis.
